statement: Among the 55 general point/line/plane constraint problems on quadrics with alpha+beta+gamma=9, at least 46 admit nonempty open sets of real inputs for which all complex solutions are real.

answer.text: Among the 55 general point/line/plane constraint problems on quadrics with alpha+beta+gamma=9, at least 46 admit nonempty open sets of real inputs for which all complex solutions are real.

source.location: Theorem 4.1, p. 6; Example 4.2 and Remark 4.3, p. 7

notes:
Does not prove total reality for all 55 cases; the 46 cases are a precisely bounded subfamily, not 46 invented independent article records.

Imported from the 2026-10-26 catalogue record R_da4203e2d42ffebe; the source claim has not been newly rechecked against the paper for this beta import.

Example 4.2 gives a rational (3,3,3) instance with 104 real tangent quadrics. The proofs certify the numerical solutions; the other nine cases have partial lower-bound records.
